Approval of Data Sharing Agreement by and between Oakland Enrolls and District, for the purpose of evaluating information relating to enrollment patterns pursuant to OUSD Board Policy 6006, entitled Quality School Development: Community of Schools (“BP 6006”), supporting the study of enrollment patterns to provide quality, equitable education to all Oakland students; and prepare one or more Reports of the findings as stated in Agreement, for the term February 27, 2020 through July 1, 2023, at no cost to the District. *
__
*This Data Sharing Agreement is responsive to previous concerns raised about a two-way data sharing agreement. Under this agreement, Oakland Enrolls (the charter application platform) will share student-level data with the District for the District’s analytic purposes. enrichment.headline: Directs the Board Secretary to cast the district's ballot for up to three California School Boards Association delegate candidates
enrichment.summary: The Board is adopting a resolution that instructs the Secretary of the Governing Board to cast the district's ballot for up to three candidates for the California School Boards Association 2020 Delegate Assembly, Sub-Region 7-B (Alameda County). The ballot must be returned with a postmark on or before March 16, 2020. No dollar amount is stated.
